title: Lost in Translation? A Comparative Study on the Cross-Lingual Transfer of Composite Harms
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze aspects of religion. It measures how safety alignment against adversarial syntax and contextual harms transfers across languages.
findings: The paper does not contain findings related to religion.
